description: HAL SPI1 + micro-SD module: SPI-mode initialization (74 clocks, CMD0, CMD8, ACMD41, CMD58), CSD capacity, block 0 (MBR) and the FAT boot sector; volume info and 'sd ok' on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. SPI1 master mode 0, MSB first: PA5 SCK, PA6 MISO (input pull-up), PA7 MOSI, PA4 = CS (push-pull, high). SCK 281 kHz (72 MHz / 256) until initialized, then 9 MHz. micro-SD module on 5 V. USART1 PA9 115200 8N1 report: 'SD card SPI test (SPI1, CS PA4)
'; 80 clocks with CS high; CMD0 (CRC 95h) up to 10 times: 'CMD0: idle (R1 0x01)' or 'CMD0: no card (R1 0xNN)' + 'sd FAILED' (no card: MISO pulled up, R1 0xFF); CMD8(1AAh): 'CMD8: v2 card, echo 0x1AA'; CMD55 + ACMD41(HCS) every millisecond: 'ACMD41: ready after N tries' (the simulated card initializes 25 ms after the first ACMD41); CMD58: 'OCR 0xC0FF8000: SDHC (block addresses)'; CMD9: 'CSD v2: 4096 MiB'; CMD17 block 0 (token FEh, CRC16 checked): 'MBR: partition 1 type 0x0C at LBA 8192, 8380416 sectors'; CMD17 of that LBA: 'FAT32 volume "OHMLET SD": 512 B/sector, 64 sectors/cluster, 32 reserved, 2 FATs x 1023 sectors, root cluster 2'; 'sd ok'. (An SDSC card prints the byte-address variant, CSD v1 and a FAT16 line.)

circuit: micro-SD module: not placed on this bench (the checks runner cannot place it; the full card sequence is covered by tests/devices/comm-firmware.test.ts)
PA4, PA5, PA6, PA7: unconnected (SPI1 + CS)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
SD card SPI test (SPI1, CS PA4)
CMD0: no card (R1 0xFF)
sd FAILED
